US Intel Sharing with Kyiv: Zelenskyy Claims Resumption, Rubio Denies Pause

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that the United States has resumed intelligence sharing with Kyiv, a system he described as an early warning for Russian missile attacks. Zelenskyy indicated this change followed discussions with American officials, including a call with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio. However, Marco Rubio denied that intelligence sharing had ever been paused. The situation unfolded amidst diplomatic efforts in Oslo concerning Ukraine peace talks.
